title: The pipeline's own tests, run by the pipeline: the queue is read again during a run
description: The runner now reads the queue again while it runs (at a nudge and every poll_seconds), so a job committed during a run starts beside the others, and pipeline.py gained nudge and wait. This job runs verification/test_pipeline.py inside the runner, at the commit that made the change. It was also queued to see the new path work on the real queue once: its commit announces it, and the verification loop, waiting for work, should start its run within seconds and not at its next 60 s look.
